events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential for further conflict in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further action against Iran.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to increased volatility in global markets, with potential for a flight to safety in US assets. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could benefit from this, while the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) could be negatively impacted.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further escalation of the conflict

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the conflict de-escalates or if the US and its allies announce a ceasefire.

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict spreads to other countries in the region

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia has announced a major partnership with SK hynix to advance memory for AI factories. This could lead to increased demand for Nvidia's AI-related products and services.
events.reasoning: The partnership between Nvidia and SK hynix could lead to increased demand for Nvidia's AI-related products and services, driving up the stock price. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) could be negatively impacted as a competitor.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further announcements from Nvidia

events.exitStrategy: Exit if Nvidia announces a major setback in its AI-related business.

gains.extendedNote: If Nvidia announces further major partnerships

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike to combat inflation. This could lead to increased volatility in financial markets.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike could lead to increased demand for shorter-term bonds, such as the iShares 1-3 Year Credit Bond ETF (CSJ). Longer-term bonds, such as the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT), could be negatively impacted.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further announcements from the Federal Reserve

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the Federal Reserve announces a pause in interest rate hikes.

gains.conservativeNote: If the interest rate hike is small
gains.extendedNote: If the interest rate hike is large
